svg.title: PB-HY-001 HYBRID paddle - general arrangement
svg.text: ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES. DO NOT SCALE THE DRAWING.
PROFILE SYMMETRICAL ABOUT THE CENTRE LINE. ALL ARCS TANGENT TO ADJOINING EDGES.
THICKNESS 16 ±0.2 UNIFORM OVER BLADE AND HANDLE (CORE + FACE SKINS).
UNLESS STATED: LINEAR ±0.5, ANGULAR ±0.5°. BREAK ALL SHARP EDGES.
EDGE GUARD, GRIP WRAP, HANDLE BUILD-UP AND BUTT CAP NOT SHOWN.
HANDLE CORE 30 × 16 (PERIMETER 92): BUILD UP ≈2–2.5 PER SIDE
USA PICKLEBALL PADDLE LIMITS: L + W = 580 ≤ 609.6 (24 in), L = 390 ≤ 431.8 (17 in).
EDGE GUARD AND BUTT CAP COUNT TOWARDS THESE LIMITS (MARGIN 29.6 mm).
PROFILE AREA 461 cm² (INCL. HANDLE), PERIMETER 1027. FULL-SIZE TEMPLATE: SHEET 2.
FACE SKIN AND CORE MATERIALS TO BE SPECIFIED.
